title: Equilibrium Instant Plumping Eye Mask
descriptionHtml:
✓ Plumping✓ Cruelty-Free
What it is: This eye mask instantly hydrates and plumps skin while reducing the look of puffiness and undereye bags for a more refreshed, wide-awake appearance.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Dryness, Loss of Firmness and Elasticity, and Puffiness

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Cell Balancing Complex™: A powerful combination of lipids (phospholipids and prolipids) that visibly rebalances, restores, and renews the skin barrier.
- Plumping Complex: Lightweight emollients that rapidly plump and smooth the appearance of lines under eyes.
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-On clean, dry skin, gently apply a thin layer to undereye area using fingertips. Leave on for at least 15 minutes, then either gently tissue off without rinsing or massage excess into skin until fully absorbed.
- Can be used alone or before makeup for an instant plumping effect and refreshing boost of hydration.
Ingredients+
Glycerin, Water/Aqua, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Isodecyl Neopentanoate, Pentylene Glycol, Sodium Acrylates Copolymer, Hydrogenated Polydecene, Phenoxyethanol, Phospholipids, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Polyglyceryl-10 Stearate, Tocopherol, Lecithin.

Ingredient lists and claims may change or vary from time to time as part of Hourglass’s commitment to innovation and maintaining global compliance. Please refer to the ingredient list on the product packaging you receive to ensure the ingredients are suitable for your personal use.
